entries.speaker: V
entries.sourceText: ¡Dale, Pilar! Pasá la harina y el agua, y decime la proporción que le da ritmo al pan, que quiero que mi horno sea una fiesta, no solo una metáfora.
entries.translation: All right, Pilar! Pass the flour and water, and tell me the ratio that gives the bread its rhythm; I want my oven to be a celebration, not just a metaphor.
entries.label: English translation
